_s9e_cmdblock_basis: s9e (javap -c of 1.21.10 and 1.21.11): 1.21.11 dropped BaseCommandBlock.getLevel() and made onUpdated() / createCommandSourceStack(source) take the ServerLevel. getLevel comes back on the base and the two vanilla sources with 1.21.10's bodies (mixin/CbCommandBlock*RestoredMixin); a converted call of the two old shapes reaches 1.21.11's with the level 1.21.10's bodies read through getLevel() (instanceRedirects, rt/CbCommandBlocks), which is also the frameDefaults judgment for an old override's frameless super call. DebugRenderer.render(pose, frustum, buffers, x, y, z, translucent) comes back over emitGizmos (mixin/CbDebugRendererRestoredMixin). TextureSetup's three view-only factories come back taking AbstractTexture's default sampler (rt/CbTextureSetups; the per-texture sampling state 1.21.10 kept on the texture is the loss).
